verdict.rationale: Attio's REST API returns JSON over HTTPS and can be used to pull all records/objects/lists programmatically (attio-docs-65, attio-docs-66), which technically enables data extraction in an open format, but there is no documented native 'export all data' feature, bulk CSV export, or GDPR-style data portability tool mentioned anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: a documented one-click/bulk export feature, explicit open-format (CSV/JSON dump) export tool, and any evidence of a straightforward 'leave with your data' workflow beyond building custom API integrations.
